capabilities: Save web articles from a URL, clipboard, note links, or a share URI, with extracted full text or metadata only
Search OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, and KCI and save papers by DOI or arXiv ID with merged scholarly metadata
Insert footnotes and bibliographies in Korean, Chicago, SBL, APA 7, or MLA 9 styles, and copy BibTeX
Organize sources with tags, topics/projects, ratings, and a customizable reading status
Generate a Bases (.base) index with views per status and separate Articles and Papers views
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English/Korean) and documents limitations (paywalled or JavaScript-only pages may yield metadata only) and which network services it contacts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture web articles and scholarly papers with their metadata, readable text, and ready-made citations in one place.

relations.evidence: Clip a page with the Obsidian Web Clipper browser extension as usual.
Full text is extracted with Mozilla Readability and converted to Markdown.

requires.name: KCI API key (and optionally an OpenAlex key for higher limits)

summary: Research source collector that saves web articles and scholarly papers as notes with metadata, full text, citations, reading status, and a Bases index.
